verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers, and server-side SDKs connect to it inside your own infrastructure. Full self-hosting of the whole platform is also documented, which keeps SDK traffic in-network. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Edge Proxy keeps serving flags when the Flagsmith API is unreachable (caching/failover behavior), client-side SDK support via the proxy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
